name: Speaker cable
description: A coil of red-and-black twin wire with banana plugs, for running an amplifier to a speaker.
notes: A coil 190 mm across of red and black twin wire held by a white twist tie, with a red and a black banana plug on the loose ends. The coil is drawn as about 3 m of wire. A salvage source of copper wire once disassembly is drafted.

name: Microphone cable
description: A short coil of black balanced audio cable with a three-pin plug at one end and the matching socket at the other.
notes: A black coil 120 mm across under a grey hook-and-loop strap, with a stainless male and female three-pin connector lying across it. The instrument cable variant shares this model: its quarter-inch jack plugs read the same at tile size. The coil is a 1.5 m patch lead.

name: Guitar stand
description: A folding tripod stand of black aluminium tube with a padded cradle and a neck yoke, for holding a guitar upright.
notes: A tripod 0.8 m tall with legs splayed 0.5 m, a rubber-padded cradle 0.26 m wide facing +z and a padded neck yoke at the top. The model stands open, mostly empty space between thin tubes. It stays an item rather than furniture: it is light and folds.

name: Headphones
description: Closed-back studio headphones with a padded headband and cushioned ear cups.
notes: Dark grey headband and ear cups with black cushions facing in and steel sliders and cup rims, standing on the cups, 0.26 m across. The model stands open as worn, and the bounding box counts the empty space under the band. No wearable is drafted: they are not hearing protection. The detachable cable and adapter are left out.

name: Microphone stand
description: A telescoping black aluminium boom stand on a folding tripod, with a counterweighted boom and a mic clip.
notes: Drawn closed: a tripod 0.7 m across, a mast 1 m tall with a clutch, and a boom 0.8 m long tilted up toward +z with a steel counterweight at the back and a clip at the front, 1.23 m tall overall. The model stands set up, mostly empty space between tubes. Drawn at an 8 mm grain so the tall stand stays light to render.

name: Microphone
description: A handheld dynamic microphone with a steel ball grille and a three-pin socket in its tail.
notes: A black handle 130 mm long tapering to the tail, a stainless collar and a grey ball grille 52 mm across pointing to +x, with brass pins in the tail socket. Held by the handle like a hand tool. The clip is left out; the stand's model carries one.

name: Mixing desk
description: An eight-channel analogue mixing desk in a steel case, with a strip of knobs and a fader per channel and stereo master faders.
notes: A dark steel case 0.44 m by 0.36 m by 0.1 m with a charcoal face: eight channel strips of four knobs and a grey fader each, red master faders, green level meters and a raised rear panel of steel sockets; the faders face +z. It is heavy for its size, as a steel-cased console. A salvage source of electronics and copper once disassembly is drafted.

name: Plectrum
description: A small rounded triangle of tortoiseshell plastic for plucking guitar strings.
notes: A red plastic pick 30 mm long and 26 mm across, tip toward +z; red rather than tortoiseshell so it reads as plastic in the tile. Real picks are under 1 mm thick; the model is one 2 mm voxel thick, the finest grain the build takes. One pick per item; no stack is drafted.
